name: @peer-agent/desktop
description: Peer Agent Desktop - AI Agent OS for Enterprise
author: Peer Agent Team <dev@peer-agent.local>

scripts.dev: pnpm ipc:generate && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/protocol build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-core build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-sdk build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-node build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/credential-helper build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/conversation-store build && node ../../scripts/build-credential-helper.mjs --profile debug && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm ipc:check && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/protocol build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-core build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-sdk build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/runtime-node build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/credential-helper build && pnpm --filter @peer-agent/conversation-store build && vite build && node scripts/verify-overlay-backdrop-filter.mjs
scripts.dev:lab: node ../../scripts/build-credential-helper.mjs --profile debug && concurrently -k "cross-env PEER_DEV_PORT=5273 vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5273 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5273 PEER_AGENT_HOME=$HOME/.peer-agent-lab electron ."
